subject: general
question: Valabhi, a city of ancient India was the capital of the _______ dynasty from the 5th to 8th Century CE.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maitraka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Maitraka dynasty ruled in the western part of India, primarily the region of present-day Gujarat.
 
• Valabhi, the capital city of the Maitraka dynasty, was an important cultural and educational center during their reign.
 
• The dynasty was founded by Senapati Bhatarka, a former Gupta Empire military commander, around the middle of the 5th century CE.
 
• The Maitrakas were patrons of Buddhism and Jainism, and Valabhi was known for its Buddhist monasteries and Jain temples.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Valabhi**

 
 
• Valabhi was an ancient city located in the present-day Bhavnagar district of Gujarat, India.
 
• It served as the capital of the Maitraka dynasty from the 5th to the 8th century CE.
 
• Valabhi was renowned as a center of learning and attracted scholars from various parts of India.
 
• The city was known for its educational institutions, particularly Buddhist monasteries, which were comparable to those at Nalanda.
 
 
 
• **Maitraka Dynasty**
 
 
• The Maitraka dynasty was founded by Senapati Bhatarka, a former military governor of the Gupta Empire.
 
• They ruled primarily over the Saurashtra region of Gujarat from the 5th to the 8th century CE.
 
• The Maitrakas played a significant role in the cultural and religious development of western India.
 
• The dynasty came to an end in the mid-8th century CE, likely due to Arab invasions and internal strife.
 
 
 
• **Gupta Empire**
 
 
• The Gupta Empire was an ancient Indian empire that existed from approximately 320 to 550 CE.
 
• Founded by Maharaja Sri Gupta, the empire is known for its achievements in the arts, architecture, sciences, religion, and philosophy.
 
• The period of the Gupta Empire is often referred to as the Golden Age of India due to the extensive cultural developments and prosperity.
 
• The Gupta rulers supported Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism, fostering a diverse cultural and religious landscape.
 
 
 
• **Buddhism and Jainism**
 
 
• Buddhism is a major world religion founded by Siddhartha Gautama, known as the Buddha, in the 5th century BCE in India.
 
• Buddhism emphasizes the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path as a way to achieve enlightenment and end suffering.
 
• Jainism is an ancient Indian religion that teaches non-violence, truth, and asceticism.
 
• Founded by Mahavira in the 6th century BCE, Jainism emphasizes the principles of non-attachment and self-discipline.
